thread:
Ava (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock MVP vs v1 cuts for the April ship window. Customer X is pressing for SSAML which looks risky for latency SLOs. Proposing a 2-week buffer + a must-have MVP list.
Jon (Eng Lead): 2-week buffer sounds reasonable. Can we move non-critical admin flows to v1? SAML integration is the big engineering risk.
Priya (Product Ops): Buffer is fine if we freeze feature merges by EOD Friday. Without the freeze the runway disappears.
Carlos (SRE): We need to reserve a dedicated capacity pool for smoke/canary tests and flag the DB migration as a blocker. Migration needs a maintenance window.
Elaine (Design): I can ship simplified screens for MVP — will trim admin pages and polish core flow. Will upload reduced mocks by EOD.
Ava (PM): Draft MVP must-haves:
- API endpoints for inference + basic auth (OAuth SSO)
- Basic telemetry + billing hooks
- Canary + smoke infra in prod
Nice-to-have for v1: SSAML, admin UI, advanced telemetry dashboards.
Jon (Eng Lead): If we skip SSAML for MVP, what's our rollback/comply plan if a customer demands it post-launch? Need clear acceptance criteria and fallback.
Priya (Product Ops): Acceptance criteria proposal:
```
- Auth: OAuth SSO functioning in prod for customer orgs
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for 512-token paths
- E2E: smoke tests + login + billing flows pass in canary
- Rollback: can revert to previous model variant within 15m if errors spike
```
Also we need a runbook for DB migration rollback.
Carlos (SRE): I can own the smoke infra and migration runbook. Migration will need 48h notice and a 2hr window.
Ava (PM): Can people react with :thumbsup: if they accept the 2-week buffer + the must-have list? Call out any blockers now.
Jon (Eng Lead): :thumbsup: from me. Need a follow-up to schedule the migration window with infra.
Elaine (Design): :thumbsup: will deliver the trimmed mocks.
Priya (Product Ops): I'll update the release checklist and set the feature freeze for Friday 17:00 PT.
Ava (PM): Locking this in for now. Follow-up 30m tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize canary plan and migration timing. @Carlos please bring the migration doc.
Carlos (SRE): Will post migration doc in the release thread and tag infra/ops.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled (placeholder): canary-window 2025-04-10T09:00Z - 2025-04-12T18:00Z.
Ava (PM): Thanks — I'll update the roadmap ticket with the cuts and timeline buffer. If any urgent objections, speak up in the AM.
